resources.performance_tooltip2: Database Transaction Units or DTUs, are a blended measure of CPU, memory, I/O (data and transaction log I/O). The ratio amongst these resources was originally determined by an OLTP benchmark workload designed to be typical of real-world OLTP workloads.
resources.singleorelastic_storage_note_c_2: Storage must be specified between 5 GB and 4 TB, in 1 GB increments. Actual storage limits apply and are based upon type, service tier and hardware generation. For more information, see our documentation on resource limits for single databases and elastic pools.
resources.managed_instance_service_tier_tooltip_te: Service tiers provide predictable performance with compute, storage and business continuity options for a variety of workloads. Learn more about vCore-based service tiers.
resources.rendundancy_info_1: Enable zone redundancy to make your databases resilient to a much larger set of failures. Learn more about high availability.

resources.reserved_instance_note: Save up to 73% on pay as you go prices with 1 year or 3 year reserved options.
resources.non_serverless_help_text: Azure SQL Database (with the exception of serverless) is billed on a predictable, hourly rate.  If the SQL database is active for less than one hour, you are billed for each hour the database exists using the highest service tier selected, provisioned storage and IO that applied during that hour, regardless of usage or whether the database was active for less than an hour.
resources.managed_instance_tooltip_text_1: Select the amount of compute (vCores) to support your requirements. Learn more about resource limits.

resources.compute_info_1: Learn how compute costs are calculated for the vCore-based purchase model.
resources.hyperscale_storage_note_a: Storage is dynamically  allocated between 40 GB and 100 TB, in 10 GB increments. Billing is  based on allocated storage.
resources.additional_iops_info_a_2: You can scale your IOPS to optimize the performance of an IO-intensive operation. You get 300 IOPS for 32, 64 and 96 GB of reserved storage or 3 included IOPS/GB per total storage provisioned if larger than 96 GB. Additional IOPS are billed per minute and rounded up to the nearest minute. See more information on additional IOPS.
